paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The perplexity standard deviations when only PvCs are reserved at each layer.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the perplexity standard deviations across a range of layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and employs a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 32, with tick labels displayed at every 4 unit intervals. The y-axis is labeled "Perplexity (log Std)" and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0.00 to 1.75. A single line is present, colored orange with a solid line style and circular markers. This line begins at a value of approximately 1.05 at x=0 and steadily declines to approximately 0.11 at x=32.
